desc: Parse input values $N$, $K$, and array $A$, and compute the XOR sum of all elements in $A$.
If $K > N/2$, swap $K$ to $N-K$ and set a flag to adjust the final XOR calculation accordingly.
Implement combination enumeration using `itertools.combinations` for efficiency.
Compute incremental XOR sums for each combination and track the maximum.
Apply complement adjustment if $K$ was swapped, then print the result.
